jobs.title: SAP ABAP Programmer
jobs.excerpt: Bright Vision Technologies is a forward-thinking software development company dedicated to building innovative solutions that help businesses automate and optimize their operations.
jobs.description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a forward-thinking software development company dedicated to building innovative solutions that help businesses automate and optimize their operations. We leverage cutting-edge technologies to create scalable, secure, and user-friendly applications.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a skilled SAP ABAP Programmer to join our dynamic team and contribute to our mission of transforming business processes through technology.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: SAP ABAP Programmer
Location: 100% Remote (Continental United States)
Position Type: In-house Bright Vision Technologies SOW engagement (no third-party client or vendor)
Salary: $100K - $150K
Experience: 5+ years

Employment Terms & Visa Policy
This is a 100% remote, full-time, direct W2 position with Bright Vision Technologies.
This role is part of Bright Vision Technologies’ in-house Statement of Work (SOW) engagement. The client, end customer, and employer for this position is Bright Vision Technologies — there is no third-party client, vendor, or implementation partner involved.
We do not engage in C2C, 1099, or third-party arrangements for this role.

Candidates must be willing to work directly as a full-time W2 employee of Bright Vision Technologies and contribute to our in-house SOW deliverables.
No new H1B sponsorship is available for this role.

However, candidates who are currently on a valid H1B visa and require a transfer are welcome to apply. We will support H1B transfers for qualified candidates.
For every role, a technical coding assessment is mandatory. Please apply only if you are confident in your technical abilities and hands-on experience.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP ABAP Programmer with strong S/4HANA expertise to design, develop, and support custom enhancements, integrations, and reports within large enterprise SAP landscapes. This role spans the full development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, hands-on coding, unit testing, performance tuning, and post-go-live support in close collaboration with functional consultants and business stakeholders. The ideal candidate will combine deep ABAP expertise — including core ABAP, ABAP OO, CDS views, AMDPs, and OData — with a strong understanding of S/4HANA architecture, Fiori integration, and clean-core principles that minimize technical debt and ease future upgrades.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop custom ABAP programs, enhancements, BAPIs, BADIs, user exits, and interfaces within SAP S/4HANA environments, following clean-core and modification-free principles wherever possible.
  • Build performant CDS views, AMDPs, and HANA-optimized ABAP code that leverages code pushdown and takes full advantage of S/4HANA’s in-memory architecture.
  • Develop and consume OData services and RESTful APIs to support Fiori applications and integrations with non-SAP systems.
  • Implement SAP Gateway services, including service registration, modeling, and lifecycle management.
  • Design and develop classical and interactive ALV reports, smart forms, Adobe forms, and modern Fiori-aligned output channels.
  • Build and maintain integration interfaces using IDocs, RFC, BAPI, Web Services, and the SAP API Hub.
  • Perform technical analysis of business requirements in collaboration with functional consultants, and translate them into well-documented technical designs.
  • Conduct thorough unit testing, support functional and integration testing, and resolve defects raised during UAT and post-go-live hypercare.
  • Lead performance tuning of ABAP code, SQL queries, and database access patterns, including the use of SAT, ST05, and HANA-specific diagnostic tools.
  • Support S/4HANA upgrades, system conversions, and code remediation activities, including SCMON / UPL analysis and clean-core readiness assessments.
  • Implement security best practices in custom developments, including authority checks, secure data handling, and compliance with internal SAP governance.
  • Document technical specifications, code reviews, and operational procedures in line with enterprise SAP standards.
  • Mentor junior ABAP developers and act as a technical reference within the SAP team.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of professional ABAP development experience, with significant time on S/4HANA.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with ABAP OO, CDS views, AMDPs, and HANA-optimized ABAP.
  • Solid experience building OData services and integrating with Fiori applications.
  • Hands-on experience with enhancement frameworks (BADIs, user exits, implicit/explicit enhancements).
  • Strong experience with integration technologies (IDoc, RFC, BAPI, Web Services).
  • Solid understanding of SAP module data structures, including FI/CO, SD, MM, or PP, depending on the project area.
  • Experience with performance tuning tools (SAT, ST05) and HANA diagnostic tools.
  • Familiarity with SAP Solution Manager, ChaRM, and SAP transport management.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with S/4HANA system conversions or greenfield implementations.
  • Exposure to SAP BTP, ABAP RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model), or steampunk.
  • Hands-on experience with Fiori/UI5 development.
  • Familiarity with SAP CPI / Integration Suite.
  • SAP-certified ABAP developer credentials.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity?
For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 505-3544. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.
We recognize that our people are our strength, and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company.
We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants’ and employees’ religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including Disability/Veterans.
Position offered by “No Fee Agency.”

Bright Vision Technologies (BV Teck) is committed to equal employment opportunity (EEO) for all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status as defined by applicable federal, state, or local laws. jobs.title: Facebook-Werbeanzeigen-Betreuung (m/w/d) - 100% Homeoffice, Teilzeit 25-30 h
jobs.excerpt: WICHTIG: Wir können nur Bewerbungen berücksichtigen, wenn du bereits selbst Werbeanzeigen im Meta Werbeanzeigenmanager (Facebook/Instagram) erstellt und bearbeitet hast.
jobs.description:
WICHTIG: Wir können nur Bewerbungen berücksichtigen, wenn du bereits selbst Werbeanzeigen im Meta Werbeanzeigenmanager (Facebook/Instagram) erstellt und bearbeitet hast. Ohne diese Erfahrung ist eine Bewerbung leider nicht sinnvoll.

Du hast Freude daran, Facebook- und Instagram-Werbeanzeigen anzulegen und zu kontrollieren, und suchst eine Aufgabe für rund 25 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche, die du zu 100% aus dem Homeoffice erledigen kannst?

Wir helfen Unternehmen dabei, durch digitales Recruiting die besten Mitarbeiter zu finden. Dafür läuft bei uns ein eingespielter Prozess: Wir wissen, welche Werbeanzeigen funktionieren, wie die Texte aufgebaut sind und wie eine Kampagne aussehen muss und welche Handgriffe es in Meta für eine erfolgreiche Kampagne braucht.

Genau diesen Prozess sollst du bei uns abarbeiten - Schritt für Schritt, Kampagne für Kampagne.

Wir wachsen weiter und suchen deshalb Unterstützung bei der Durchführung unserer Projekte.

Deine Aufgaben

Grundvoraussetzung für diese Stelle: Anlegen von Kampagnen in Meta (Verwendung des Ad Managers von Meta)

Eingabe und Änderung von Meta/Facebook/Instagram Werbeanzeigen (Ads) im Meta Business Manager

Du legst unsere Kunden in BVS an und erstellst die Verknüpfungen, so dass die Bewerber auch an den Kunden weitergeleitet werden.

Betreuen unserer Recruiting-Kampagnen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Projektleiterin, nach unserem bestehenden System

Als Urlaubsvertretung übernimmst du die Gestaltung von Kampagnen in Canva und erstellst die passenden Texte für neue Kampagnen. Du arbeitest mit unseren Vorlagen und setzt daraus ansprechende Anzeigen und Grafiken um.

Du musst nicht (!) zwingend Vorerfahrung im Recruiting, HR oder Projektmanagement haben

Das bringst du mit

Du hast eingehende Erfahrung im Umgang mit Meta (Facebook/Instagram). Du hast Freude daran Anzeigen anzulegen, zu ändern und zu kontrollieren.

Das Wichtigste vorweg: Unser Prozess steht, er funktioniert, und er ist in Vorlagen und Abläufen festgehalten. Deine Aufgabe ist es, ihn sauber, genau und verlässlich abzuarbeiten - nicht, ihn neu zu erfinden.

Sorgfalt und Genauigkeit sind uns wichtiger als originelle Einfälle. Wer gerne nach einem klaren System arbeitet, ist bei uns richtig.

Du hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, wann etwas ansprechend aussieht? Dann freuen wir uns auf dich.

Offenheit und Interesse an neuen Ideen, Programmen und Tools

Eigenständiges Denken und sauberes, strukturiertes Arbeiten mit Hausverstand sind für dich selbstverständlich und keine Ausnahme.

Du kannst gut damit umgehen, dass kurzfristige Todos immer wieder aufploppen, und priorisierst Aufgaben.

Du arbeitest nicht nach starren Zeiten – kannst dich gut organisieren und einteilen.

Sehr guter Umgang mit dem Computer (Windows oder Mac, MS Office)

Regelmäßige Kommunikation deiner Fortschritte in internen Online-Meetings

Ein Hinweis in eigener Sache: Ausgebildete und erfahrene Grafikerinnen und Grafiker sind bei uns unterfordert - die Aufgabe ist die Umsetzung mit Vorlagen, nicht die freie Gestaltung.

Das bieten wir

Teilzeit (25-30 Stunden / Woche), auf Wunsch später mehr

Gemeinsame Zusammenarbeit online im kleinen Team mit eigener Verantwortung

Du kannst nach unserem eigens entwickelten System arbeiten und bekommst alles beigebracht

100% Arbeit aus dem Home-Office möglich – bitte keine Digitalen Nomaden

Klare Abläufe statt ständig wechselnder Anforderungen - du weißt, was zu tun ist

Gehalt: Wir bezahlen das kollektivvertragliche Mindestgehalt laut Kollektivvertrag für Angestellte im Gewerbe, Handwerk und in der Dienstleistung, Verwendungsgruppe 2, Einstieg ohne Vorerfahrung. Das sind € 2.059,41 brutto pro Monat bei Vollzeit (40 Stunden), 14-mal im Jahr. Bei 25 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche entspricht das € 1.287,13 bis € 1.544,56 brutto pro Monat. Eine Überzahlung ist nicht vorgesehen.

Bitte beachte: Diese Stelle ist sehr begehrt - wegen der Freiheiten, die wir bieten, und weil du zu 100% im Homeoffice arbeitest. Eine Bewerbung ist deshalb nur dann sinnvoll, wenn du praktische Erfahrung mit Meta-Ads mitbringst, wenn das angegebene Gehalt für dich passt und dir bewusst ist, dass es in den ersten 2 Jahren nicht steigen wird (ausgenommen die jährliche kollektivvertragliche Anpassung). Andernfalls ist eine Bewerbung hinfällig.

Art der Stelle: Teilzeit, Freie Mitarbeit, Minijob

Interessiert? Melde dich bei uns und lass uns sprechen (Lebenslauf und deine Kontaktdaten reichen aus - kein Motivationsschreiben).

jobs.description:
Let Us Introduce Ourselves

We’re Patriot Software - a remote-first, product-led tech company on a mission to make accounting and payroll fast, simple, and affordable for millions of American businesses. With 175+ team members across the U.S. and a collaborative office hub in Canton, Ohio, we’re building software that empowers the backbone of the American economy.

What We Believe In

Creating great products starts with creating an environment where people thrive. That means connection, clarity, growth, high trust, and a culture where ideas move quickly and quality matters.

Our team lives by six core values that guide how we work, build, and serve:

  • Be Customer Obsessed: We start with our customers and work backward to deliver exceptional value.
  • Lead With Speed: We move fast, take smart risks, and stay ahead by acting boldly.
  • Don’t Cut Corners: We own our technologies and operations to deliver a high-quality, end-to-end experience.
  • Create a Better Us: We simplify, automate, spend wisely, and continuously improve.
  • Follow the Golden Rule: We treat others with respect, invite feedback, and commit even when we disagree.
  • Grow, Be a Leader: We expect leadership at all levels and pursue excellence as a high-accountability, high-trust team.

If this sounds like a place where you’d thrive, keep reading—your next opportunity might be here.

Summary:

  • Job Title: QA Analyst II
  • Job Status: Full-time
  • Location: Remote
  • Compensation: Salaried (Exempt)
  • Position Type: Direct Hire, note, this is not a contract role
  • Pay Range: $65K - $78K, based on experience
  • Shift: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM ET, Monday - Friday

We are looking for a talented QA Analyst who will take ownership of the quality of our software suite. We want someone who will test our system and find bugs in every layer of our multiple applications. As part of an agile development team, the successful candidate will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive test cases for both the back and the front end. This individual will love manual testing and use a combination of UI, database, and API interfaces to ensure our products work as desired.

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Collaborate closely with the development team to understand requirements and create thorough test plans.
  • Identify, analyze, and document issues; recommend solutions and improvements.
  • Manage manual, regression, usability, and exploratory testing processes.
  • Maintain meticulous attention to detail and clearly communicate findings to team members.
  • Dive into the product with enthusiasm to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
  • Keep the team informed of progress, roadblocks, and any emerging issues.
  • Identify critical software areas to ensure adequate test coverage.
  • Gather essential data and perform root cause analysis to assess defects and their impact.
  • Ensure defect traceability and conduct in-depth root cause analysis.
  • Track and report on deliverables to maintain visibility of testing progress.
  • Monitor testing efforts across teams to meet deadlines effectively.
  • Develop metrics and reports to clearly communicate test status throughout the process.

Please note this is a sample of what you’ll be doing. This job requires you to be able to adapt to change quickly in order to deliver an exceptional customer experience. Your duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

What You’ll Need:

  • A degree in a related discipline, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in Quality Assurance testing, including web applications and API testing.
  • Familiarity with SQL and databases.
  • Proficiency in leveraging artificial intelligence technologies, crafting precise prompts, and systematically validating generated results for precision as toolsets advance.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on precision, thoroughness, and a proactive approach to enhancing quality.
  • Strong sense of ownership and initiative, with a proactive approach to seeking help and offering support to teammates when necessary.
  • Capacity to work independently with minimal supervision and assist multiple teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated teamwork skills, partnering with colleagues to maintain high testing standards and consistency across the QA process.
  • Openness to feedback and willingness to offer constructive input and share expertise to foster team development.
  • This role requires sitting or standing for extended periods (8+ hours) while working on a computer, including prolonged screen time, extended keyboard and mouse use, and repetitive typing.
  • Home Office Setup: Candidates should have a dedicated, quiet workspace with reliable high-speed internet, a desk, and a chair. Patriot provides a home office stipend to help you set up or enhance your home office after the successful completion of your introductory period.

Location & Commitments

Equal Opportunity

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and to applicants and employees with pregnancy-related limitations. If you need an accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact People Operations.

More Reasons to Love Patriot

Great products start with great people—which is why we invest in our team so they can do their best work. In addition to a culture that encourages innovation and ownership, our full-time employees enjoy a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help our team thrive inside and outside of work.

  • Paid time off, inclusive of vacation and sick time
  • Paid holidays
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Section 125 HSA and FSA accounts
  • Benefits beginning the first of the month following hire
  • Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Up-to-date hardware and equipment provided
  • Flexible scheduling and opportunities for advancement

jobs.description:
About The Princeton Review:

The Princeton Review is a leading tutoring, test prep, and college admission services company. Every year, it helps millions of students bound for college and graduate school to achieve their education and career goals through online and in-person courses delivered by a network of more than 4,000 teachers and tutors, online resources, and its more than 150 print and digital books published by Penguin Random House. The company’s Tutor.com brand is one of the largest online tutoring services in the U.S. It comprises a community of thousands of tutors who have delivered more than 19 million one-to-one tutoring sessions. The Princeton Review is headquartered in New York, NY. Follow the company on LinkedIn, YouTube and Instagram.

Don’t See Your Subject? Join Tutor Talent Community

Tutor.com is always looking to connect with great tutors and educators. If you don’t currently see an opening for the subject you teach, join our Tutor Talent Community.

By submitting your information, you’ll be on our radar for future 1:1 tutoring opportunities that match your subject area. When something opens up, our team can reach out to let you know.

Whether you teach math, science, English, history, test prep, or another subject, we’d love to stay connected.

Join our Tutor Talent Community today and be among the first to hear about future opportunities with Tutor.com!

The company does not provide benefits for this position.
Applications accepted on an ongoing basis.
Please note that the above-referenced position can be performed anywhere in the United States except in the following states: Arkansas, Hawaii, Idaho, Mississippi, New Mexico, North Dakota, Rhode Island, South Dakota and Wyoming.
The Princeton Review is an equal employment opportunity employer. The Princeton Review’s policy is not to discriminate against any applicant or employee based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, military status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. The Princeton Review also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories. It is also The Princeton Review’s policy to comply with all applicable laws respecting consideration of unemployment status in making hiring decisions.

The Princeton Review is a drug-free workplace.

Pursuant to, and consistent with, any applicable state or local laws, such as the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, New York City Fair Chance Act, Philadelphia’s Fair Chance Hiring Law, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, The Princeton Review will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.
